# Warrior's Call — legal pages

The privacy policy and terms of use for the game **Warrior's Call**, published
here so the stores and the players have a public URL that stays up.

- https://yangyangdotcom.github.io/warriors-call-legal/privacy.html
- https://yangyangdotcom.github.io/warriors-call-legal/terms.html

**Do not edit the HTML here.** It is generated. The text lives in `src/legal.ts`
in the game's own (private) repo, which the game also reads to show both
documents inside the app, so a player and a store reviewer can never be looking
at different words. To change either document, edit that module, run
`npm run legal`, and copy the three files here.
